title: Sign-in device-flow: user denies the request -> honest needs-sign-in holding, never fabricated success
notes: S3: any miss/deny/expire/timeout renders the EXISTING doctor `signed-out` holding state (solid + key badge + 'Sign in...') rather than inventing a new terminal or a raw OAuth/error string -- reuses corpus/signed-out-claude-personal.json, whose checker already anticipates the repair token 'cc auth login'.
